_comment: Deduplication rules (MASTER_PROMPT section 31). Every record gets all applicable keys; a new record is a duplicate of an existing one when ANY key matches. `duplicate_key` stores the highest-priority key. Different emails at the same company are different people and are never merged.

keyPriority.description: Priority 2 - same person (normalised full name) + same company (legal suffixes ignored).
Priority 3 - ORGANIZATION records: same organisation + same contact point (website host, else phone digits).

merge.description: On a duplicate, only blank fields of the existing record are filled from the new one. Existing non-blank values are never overwritten; differing values are counted as conflicts in the run report. New source URLs are appended to source_history so original provenance is preserved.
